question: For DOWN ports in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return each port’s name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows (ordered by port ID). Also include (for the same port status and device owner) the total number of non-shared ports whose standard attribute resource type is `ports` plus the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp, but only keep rows where that port_count is greater than the average port_count across all (status, device_owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         p.name,
         p.network_id,
         p.mac_address,
         p.admin_state_up,
         p.status,
         p.device_owner,
         sgb.security_group_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.network_id = '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d'
    AND p.status = 'DOWN'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT b.id,
         b.name,
         b.network_id,
         b.mac_address,
         b.admin_state_up,
         b.status,
         b.device_owner,
         b.security_group_id,
         MIN(b.admin_state_up) OVER (
           ORDER BY b.id
           ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
         ) AS min_admin_state_up
  FROM base b
),
port_counts AS (
  SELECT p.status,
         p.device_owner,
         COUNT(p.id) AS port_count,
         MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND NOT p.network_id IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id
      FROM networkrbacs nr
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = p.tenant_id)
    )
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
),
avg_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count
  FROM port_counts
)
SELECT w.name,
       w.network_id,

FROM windowed w
JOIN port_counts pc ON w.status = pc.status AND w.device_owner = pc.device_owner
